findings.claim: Across the full observed score window [0.0,0.49], the two probed landmarks' endpoint-world displacement components show no accepted polynomial trend: every probed curve has polynomial_accepted=false and relative_node_RMSE between 0.29 and 0.83, so whole-window means are near zero (whole_window_z between -0.30 and +0.64) while node-level values oscillate with 4-10 sign changes and 1-13 strong_sign_conflicts across 14 independent batches.

The probed curves show large first-vs-last rate contrasts (e.g. landmark_00_local_dx first_rate_z=-17.49 vs last_rate_z=+8.11; landmark_10_soft_mass first_rate_z=+66.28 vs last_rate_z=-11.56), but these are local node slopes, not an absolute coordinate target or a spatial gradient, and they are not evidence of an optimal guidance dose.

Only 8 of 200 catalogue curve features were read in this pass; the remaining 192 features (including all local_cxx/cxy/cxz/cyy/cyz/czz components and landmarks 01-09, 11-19) are unqueried, which is distinct from absent.

hypotheses.direction: test weaker early / stronger later redistribution (W1_early_soft) versus M2
hypotheses.falsifier: If the W1_early_soft run does not change the landmark_00_local_dx node profile relative to M2 (same sign pattern and comparable node z-values), or if the primary final-affinity metric does not improve, the timing hypothesis is not supported.
hypotheses.observable: landmark_00_local_dx (predicted endpoint world x-displacement, z-scored per node)
hypotheses.scope: whole observed score window [0.0,0.49], all 50 observed score nodes
hypotheses.statement: For landmark_00, the endpoint-world x-displacement coordinate oscillates with a mid-window positive excursion (values_z rising to ~0.85 near t~0.10-0.11) followed by a negative trough (values_z ~ -1.4 near t~0.19) and partial recovery, with no accepted polynomial trend; a temporal dose recipe that redistributes guidance weight toward the early/mid nodes (e.g. W1_early_soft) is worth testing against the same M2 reward geometry, because the observed sign reversal means a single stationary dose cannot match both the early positive and mid negative contrast.

hypotheses.falsifier: If the W2_middle_peak run leaves the landmark_00_soft_mass mid-window plateau unchanged relative to M2, or if the primary final-affinity metric does not improve, the mid-window timing hypothesis is not supported.
hypotheses.observable: landmark_00_soft_mass (z-scored soft occupancy mass at landmark_00)
hypotheses.statement: For landmark_00, the soft-mass coordinate rises from a negative start (values_z ~ -0.37 at t=0) to a positive plateau (values_z ~ +1.0 to +1.6 across t~0.14-0.30) and then declines toward zero by t~0.49, with the smallest relative_node_RMSE (0.29) among the probed curves; this is the most stable probed observable and motivates testing whether a mid-window emphasis (W2_middle_peak) changes the mid-window mass plateau without altering the frozen reward geometry.

hypotheses.direction: test early-strong (W3) versus early-soft (W1) dose ordering
hypotheses.falsifier: If W1 and W3 produce indistinguishable landmark_10_soft_mass trajectories (same sign pattern and comparable node z-values), or if neither improves the primary final-affinity metric over M2, the early-vs-late ordering hypothesis is not supported.
hypotheses.observable: landmark_10_soft_mass (z-scored soft occupancy mass at landmark_10)
hypotheses.statement: For landmark_10, the soft-mass coordinate shows an early positive excursion (values_z ~ +0.7 to +1.0 across t~0.02-0.05) followed by a monotone decline to negative values by t~0.49 (values_z ~ -0.37), with first_rate_z=+66.28 and last_rate_z=-11.56; this early-vs-late sign reversal is a candidate for testing whether early-strong control (W3_early_strong_control) versus early-soft control (W1_early_soft) produces distinguishable landmark_10 mass trajectories.

limitations: Only 8 of 200 catalogue curve features were read; the remaining 192 features are unqueried, not absent.
No stage profiles or temporal profiles are available; only continuous per-node curves were used.

All probed curves have polynomial_accepted=false and high relative_node_RMSE (0.29-0.83), so no smooth whole-window trend is established; node-level oscillations may reflect clone dependence or batch turnover rather than a stable temporal signal.
Selection preference and coordinate contrasts are associations only; no descendant survival, decoded final affinity, or measured guidance benefit is observed in this role input.
The probed curves are untyped coordinate proxies; no energy or chemical-interaction interpretation is attached.
A contrast or its time derivative does not specify an absolute coordinate target or spatial gradient, and no optimal guidance dose is estimated here.
